title: Research Console v0.3 — Local Read-Only C2 Sequence-Evidence Presentation
permits_after_pass: Enable one local read-only Research Console route: RESEARCH.C2_SEQUENCE_EVIDENCE.
Consume only exact approved RO4 projection objects bound to the accepted schema and source identities.
Present C2 states, transitions, persistence/conflict evidence, non-canonical sequences, read-only boundary/friction records, signature-diversity evidence and disclosed samples in separated panels.
Present Pattern Discovery trigger-trace identities only, without candidate population, ranking, review or write access.
Present Discovery and Development references only under exact accepted release and manifest bindings.

C2 mutation, selector/release change, recomputation, tuning or promotion
Pattern Discovery candidate population, ranking, review-batch or evidence-bridge access
Validation record, path or payload resolution
Percentage, ratio, heatmap, likelihood or silent-sampling presentation
Semantic, family, model, candidate or theory promotion
Outcome joining, probability, risk, exposure, trading, execution or agent write

NO ANNOTATION OR WRITE ACTIONS ARE AVAILABLE.
C2 AND PATTERN DISCOVERY AUTHORITY IS UNCHANGED.

prohibited: Alter C2 or Pattern Discovery outputs

Add a fail-closed local route registration that accepts only the approved RC-G5 authority registry, schema identities and hashes.
Add the C2 Sequence Evidence surface to the Research Console with the eight separated panel classes and permanent banners.
Keep every action and annotation control absent; preserve writes NONE and local-only deployment.
Add focused UI/source tests for no-write, Validation denial, PD isolation, denominator visibility, sample disclosure and permanent banners.
Run focused and complete repository tests, prepare an activation receipt and squash-merge only if the implementation remains inside this approved delta.
recommendation_rationale: RO4-G5 is merged, all required adapter, no-write, source-isolation and complete-suite checks pass, no unresolved issue exists, and rollback is bounded and non-destructive.
